title.zh: 霍尔木兹危机推高全球原油运输成本，运费从每桶3美元飙升至20美元以上
title.en: 霍尔木兹危机推高全球原油运输成本，运费从每桶3美元飙升至20美元以上

current_state.zh: Goldman reports global crude shipping costs have jumped from about $3 to over $20 per barrel, with Middle East routes above $35, as the Hormuz crisis raises war-risk premiums, fuel costs, ship-to-ship transfers and rerouting, widening Brent-WTI spreads and pressuring refiners and energy inflation.
current_state.en: Goldman reports global crude shipping costs have jumped from about $3 to over $20 per barrel, with Middle East routes above $35, as the Hormuz crisis raises war-risk premiums, fuel costs, ship-to-ship transfers and rerouting, widening Brent-WTI spreads and pressuring refiners and energy inflation.
